Then "Suspected" (the same text on a diagonal-hatch ground, two lines): "3:10 A rival car parks near the pickup"; "The café waitress is in debt". Atomic power made everything physical abundant; thinking machines and networks never came, so the interface is clockwork-smart: enamel panels, chrome bezels, dot-matrix display windows, stamped paper records; never a touchscreen, hologram, glass blur or app-style flat design. Streamline Moderne, Art Deco and Googie; clean, prosperous and graceful. Materials: cream and ivory enamel, seafoam and deep-teal faience bands, chrome, a thin brushed-brass hairline only (brass is never a large surface). Drawn flat and crisp and readable at 1080p: no glow, no drop shadows, no gradients on panels, no grime, no present-day phone or app interface, no sci-fi neon. Canvas rule: the interface occupies only the middle 16:9 band of the canvas; the top 80 px and the bottom 80 px of the canvas are flat magenta #ff00ff. Everything that is not an interface panel is one flat, perfectly even, solid magenta #ff00ff: it stands for the game picture, with no scene, no shadow, no gradient and no vignette on it. Magenta never appears inside a panel. All panels are fully opaque. Colour rules: interface colours are ivory #eee9da, cream #f7f4ec, deep teal #1f6c67, seafoam #72b5a7, ink teal #17302f, chrome grey, a brass hairline #99784d, and one highlight, turquoise #1cb9c6, used only for the selected item and for planned previews. No amber, no violet, no orange, no gold surfaces and no red anywhere, with one exception: a refused marker is a tiny round dark display window holding a tiny red slashed-circle pictogram. Lit lamps and active states are bright cream, never coloured. Text rule: use only the exact words and numbers quoted in this prompt, spelled exactly; no other words, no logos, no watermark. Where a label is not quoted, draw a small pictogram instead. Pictograms: coin = cash; stopwatch = time; fingerprint = Trail; beacon lamp = Alert; padlock = locked; dotted ring with a question mark = unknown; check mark in a seafoam disc = known or works; slashed circle in a tiny dark window = refused.
